articles.title: OBS & TikTok Live Studio Overlay Setup
articles.answer_en:
### 🎬 How to Add Overlays in OBS & TikTok Live Studio:

1. Open **OBS Studio** or **TikTok Live Studio**.
2. In your **Scenes / Sources** panel, click **+ Add Source** and choose **Browser**.
3. Enter the local URL of the overlay you want to display:
   - **Wheel & Reel**: `http://localhost:8080/overlay-spinner.html`
   - **Live Gift Counter**: `http://localhost:8080/overlay-counter.html`
   - **Side Overlay (Leaderboard & Triggers)**: `http://localhost:8080/overlay-side.html`
   - **Gacha Capsule Machine**: `http://localhost:8080/overlay-gacha.html`
   - **Song Request & Spinning Vinyl**: `http://localhost:8080/overlay-songrequest.html`
   - **Team Battle (Red vs Blue)**: `http://localhost:8080/overlay-teambattle.html`
   - **Physics Coin Jar**: `http://localhost:8080/overlay-jar.html`
4. Set the Recommended Canvas Size:
   - **Vertical Mobile Stream (9:16)**: Width `1080` × Height `1920`
   - **Horizontal Standard Stream (16:9)**: Width `1920` × Height `1080`
5. Check the box **'Shutdown source when not visible'** (optional) and click **OK**.
6. Make sure RENEarn Studio is running on **port 8080**!
articles.answer_tl:
### 🎬 Paano Maglagay ng Overlays sa OBS / TikTok Live Studio:

1. Buksan ang **OBS Studio** o **TikTok Live Studio**.
2. Sa **Sources** panel, i-click ang **+** at piliin ang **Browser Source**.
3. I-paste ang local URL ng gusto mong overlay:
   - **Wheel & Reel**: `http://localhost:8080/overlay-spinner.html`
   - **Live Gift Counter**: `http://localhost:8080/overlay-counter.html`
   - **Side Overlay**: `http://localhost:8080/overlay-side.html`
   - **Gacha Machine**: `http://localhost:8080/overlay-gacha.html`
   - **Song Request & Vinyl**: `http://localhost:8080/overlay-songrequest.html`
   - **Team Battle**: `http://localhost:8080/overlay-teambattle.html`
   - **Interactive Jar**: `http://localhost:8080/overlay-jar.html`
4. Recommended Resolution:
   - **Vertical (Mobile 9:16)**: `1080` width × `1920` height
   - **Horizontal (16:9)**: `1920` width × `1080` height
5. Siguraduhing tumatakbo ang Studio server sa **port 8080**!

articles.title: Song Request & Spinning Vinyl Player Overlay
articles.answer_en:
### 🎶 Setting Up the Song Request & Vinyl Overlay:

1. **Add the Overlay to OBS**:
   - Add a Browser Source with URL: `http://localhost:8080/overlay-songrequest.html`
   - Recommended resolution: Width `1080` × Height `1920` (or `600` × `350` for just the player widget).
2. **Viewer Chat Commands**:
   - Viewers can type `!play <song name>` or `!sr <song title or artist>` directly in your live stream chat to request songs.
3. **Spotify Integration**:
   - Connect Spotify in the **Song Request** dashboard tab to automatically push viewer requests directly into your active Spotify playback queue.
4. **Streamer Controls**:
   - Streamers can skip (`!skip`), clear the queue, or blacklist inappropriate tracks directly from the dashboard.
articles.answer_tl:
### 🎶 Song Request at Vinyl Player Overlay Guide:

1. **Ilagay sa OBS**:
   - Mag-add ng Browser Source gamit ang URL: `http://localhost:8080/overlay-songrequest.html`
2. **Chat Commands ng Viewers**:
   - Mag-type lang ang viewers ng `!play <pangalan ng kanta>` sa live stream chat para pumila ang kanta.
3. **Spotify Integration**:
   - Sa **Song Request** tab, i-connect ang Spotify para kusang pumasok sa queue ang mga kanta!
4. **Overlay Animation**:
   - May animated 33 RPM spinning vinyl record, cover art, requester username, at audio visualizer!

articles.title: Linking TikTok Gifts to In-Game Spawns & Commands
articles.answer_en:
### 🎁 How to Link TikTok Gifts to In-Game Spawns:

1. Go to the **Gift Commands** tab in the left sidebar navigation.
2. Choose which gift to map (e.g. **Rose**, **Perfume**, **Heart Me**, **GG**, **Galaxy**, etc.).
3. Click the **+** button on the trigger card to assign in-game commands:
   - **In-Game Unit Summons**: Select unit (e.g. *Ultimate Spruce*, *Titan Gargantuar*, *Nuclear Doom Cherry*).
   - **Simulated Keystrokes**: Assign hotkeys (1–9, Space, Q, E) to trigger spells or activate in-game items.
   - **Coordinate Clicks**: Assign calibrated screen coordinates to click buttons or tiles inside your game.
   - **Lucky Wheel Spin**: Trigger a reel or wheel spin whenever the gift is received.
4. Configure **Repetition**, **Interval (ms)**, and **Multiplier** (spawns scale with gift count).
5. Click **Save**—triggers are live instantly with 0ms latency!
articles.answer_tl:
### 🎁 Paano I-link ang TikTok Gifts sa In-Game Actions:

1. Pumunta sa **Gift Commands** sa kaliwang navigation menu.
2. Piliin ang regalong gusto mong i-assign (hal. **Rose**, **Perfume**, **Heart Me**, **Galaxy**).
3. I-click ang **+** para magdagdag ng command:
   - **Unit Spawn**: Pumili ng unit (hal. *Titan Gargantuar*, *Ultimate Spruce*).
   - **Keystrokes**: Magpindot ng hotkey (1-9, Space, Q, E).
   - **Screen Click**: Mag-click sa eksaktong coordinate sa screen ng laro.
   - **Lucky Wheel**: Magpaikot ng roulette tuwing may nag-regalo.
4. I-set ang dami (Repetition) at multiplier kung gaano karami ang lalabas.
5. I-save at aktibo na agad ito sa live stream mo!

articles.title: Connecting TikTok LIVE to RENEarn Studio
articles.answer_en:
### 📱 How to Connect TikTok LIVE Stream:

1. Open **TikTok LIVE Studio** on your PC and start your live stream.
2. In RENEarn Studio, locate the **TikTok LIVE Stream Connection** card on the main dashboard.
3. Type your TikTok `@username` in the input field.
4. Click the pink **Connect** button.
5. The status pill will flip to **LIVE CONNECTED ✓** and your Webcast Room ID, live Viewers, and Likes will appear in real-time!

*(Note: Your TikTok account must be actively streaming LIVE before clicking Connect, otherwise the TikTok server will report 'Room not found'.)*
articles.answer_tl:
### 📱 Paano I-connect ang TikTok LIVE sa Studio:

1. Buksan ang **TikTok LIVE Studio** sa PC at simulan ang iyong live stream.
2. Sa RENEarn Studio dashboard, hanapin ang **TikTok LIVE Stream Connection** card.
3. I-type ang iyong TikTok `@username` sa kahon.
4. I-click ang pink **Connect** button.
5. Magiging **LIVE CONNECTED ✓** ang status at lalabas agad ang iyong Room ID, Viewers, at Likes!

*(Tandaan: Dapat LIVE ka na muna sa TikTok bago mag-click ng Connect para mahanap ang live room mo.)*

articles.title: Lucky Wheel, 3D Slots & Gacha Box Overlays
articles.answer_en:
### 🎡 Lucky Wheel & Gacha Overlay Modes:

The studio provides 4 dynamic visualizer modes via `http://localhost:8080/overlay-spinner.html`:
1. **Horizontal CS:GO Reel**: Ticker tape with rarity borders and sound effects.
2. **Classic 2D Wheel**: High-precision spinning wheel with customizable sector weights.
3. **3D Vegas Slot Machine**: 3-cylinder reel spinner with jackpot alerts.
4. **3D Gacha Box / UFO Claw**: Japanese capsule dropper with physics bounces.

Customize prizes, weights, rarity colors, and avatar needles in the **Lucky Wheel** tab!

articles.title: Troubleshooting & Common Fixes
articles.answer_en:
### 🔧 Quick Troubleshooting Checklist:

1. **Overlay is Blank in OBS**:
   - Verify `Launch_Studio.bat` or `RENEarn_Studio.exe` is running.
   - Open `http://localhost:8080` in your web browser. If it loads, right-click the browser source in OBS and click **'Refresh cache of current page'**.
2. **Game Commands Not Executing**:
   - Make sure your game window is running in **Borderless** or **Windowed** mode (not exclusive full-screen).
   - Check the header: the **Game Connected** pill should be green.
   - For PvZ Fusion, verify MelonLoader is installed and game port 5003 is open.
3. **TikTok LIVE Disconnects**:
   - Ensure you are already LIVE in TikTok LIVE Studio before pressing Connect.
   - Check that you typed the username without extra spaces.
articles.answer_tl:
### 🔧 Gabay sa Pag-aayos ng Problema:

1. **Blanko ang Overlay sa OBS**:
   - Siguraduhing tumatakbo ang Studio server sa port 8080.
   - Sa OBS, i-right click ang Browser Source at piliin ang **'Refresh cache of current page'**.
2. **Hindi gumagana ang in-game spawns**:
   - I-set ang laro sa **Borderless** o **Windowed** mode (huwag full-screen).
   - Tignan ang top bar kung green ang indicator ng game.
3. **Ayaw mag-connect sa TikTok**:
   - Siguraduhing LIVE ka na sa TikTok LIVE Studio bago mo i-click ang Connect sa dashboard.
